Title: A Business Sales Agent is turned away from the portal API
Steps: 1. sign in as the Business Sales Agent 2. GET `/manager/api/team`
Expected result: a redirect or 401/403; no team data

Title: Portal payloads carry no credential fields
Steps: 1. GET `/manager/api/team`, `/manager/api/kpis`, `/manager/api/feed` 2. scan each raw body for credential keys
Expected result: HTTP 200 and no `password` / `remember_token` / token keys in any body

Title: An unknown portal API path is not served as data
Expected result: HTTP 404 (or a redirect); no JSON data; no stack trace
